# Always-on rules

Mirror of the Cursor rules that apply to every session. The originals stay authoritative: edit
`.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, then rerun the generator. Rules with `globs` are not mirrored — they are
read on demand through the law gate in `AGENTS.md`.

## core.artifacts

source: `.cursor/rules/core.artifacts.mdc`
description: Artifact location — comments/ is scratch (gitignored, deletable); durable docs go to docs/

### Artifact location — `comments/` là scratch, không phải nơi lưu

**Prerequisite:** `core.law-gate.mdc` (`AGENTS.md` Read this session).

#### The rule

`comments/` — nhất là `comments/artifacts/` — là **scratch**. `.gitignore:2` ghi nguyên văn:
`# comments/artifacts is scratch: drafts only, never tracked`. Người vận hành xác nhận (2026-11-06):
*"folder này là tmp folder, sẽ xóa bất cứ lúc nào, đừng dùng folder comments/"*.

**NEVER** ghi vào đó thứ sẽ còn phải đọc lại: thiết kế, recon, plan, handover, hay evidence sẽ cite.

| Thứ cần lưu | Chỗ |
|---|---|
| Sản phẩm **đang là** gì (reference, mô tả code đang chạy) | `docs/<NN.topic>/` — gói bàn giao, folder số |
| Sản phẩm **đi đâu**: thiết kế · yêu cầu · quyết định · WBS | `sdlc/<NN.folder>/` — A, không ship, không provision |
| Luật · chuẩn · governance | `sdlc/02.governance/` |
| Script · hạ tầng | `scripts/` |
| Tạm trong một phiên, không cần giữ | `/tmp` — **ngoài** repo |
| Nháp đang tranh luận, chắc chắn bỏ | `comments/artifacts/` (được phép, nhưng **đừng cite**) |

#### Why this rule exists (defect)

Phiên 2026-11-06 ghi 4 tài liệu thiết kế (`01.paseo-concept-extract` · `02.eso-layout-concept` ·
`03.paseo-cp-integration` · `04.spec-drafts`) vào `comments/artifacts/ui-concept-paseo/`. Chúng **không
được track** (gitignore) nên `git status` vẫn sạch — không có tín hiệu nào cho thấy chúng đang mất dần.
Người vận hành phải nói ra mới biết. Đã chuyển sang `docs/10.ui/` — rồi **sai tiếp**: thiết kế và
yêu cầu là *hướng đi*, nên cùng ngày phải chuyển tiếp vào `sdlc/` (`04.landscape` · `08.ui-design` ·
`07.technical`). Ghi cả hai lần vấp, vì lần thứ hai mới là lần đúng luật.

Bài học: scratch folder **không có tín hiệu mất mát**. Chọn chỗ lưu theo **vòng đời của tài liệu**,
không theo sự tiện tay lúc viết.

#### Check

`review` — khi review một thay đổi có file mới dưới `comments/`, hỏi: tài liệu này có được cite ở đâu
không? Nếu có, nó phải nằm dưới `docs/` hoặc `sdlc/`.

## core.conversation-hygiene

source: `.cursor/rules/core.conversation-hygiene.mdc`
description: Conversation hygiene — token optimization, AgentMemory early search, docgraph/codegraph mandate, slice reading, shell limit

### Conversation Hygiene & Token Discipline

#### 1. AgentMemory First (Truy vấn ngữ cảnh sớm)
- Luôn gọi `memory_smart_search` ngay đầu turn để thu thập context phiên trước, ticket ID, symbol, file path và từ khóa then chốt.
- Dùng từ khóa này làm đầu vào chính xác cho Docgraph và Codegraph, tránh query mò mẫm làm tăng token.

#### 2. Docgraph First (No Markdown Bloat)
- Tra cứu concept, invariant, contract bằng `docgraph --q "<terms>"` (hoặc MCP `docgraph_query`) để lấy đúng đoạn 30–50 dòng.
- **Chỉ dùng `view_file` / `Read` khi Docgraph không có kết quả hoặc bắt buộc phải xem toàn văn file**.

#### 3. Codegraph First (No Code Bloat)
- Dùng `codegraph_explore` (projectPath = harness-eso) khảo sát AST, call path và symbols trong 1 round-trip.
- **Chỉ dùng `Grep` + `Read` khi Codegraph thiếu thông tin hoặc cần quét regex cụ thể**.

#### 4. Kỷ luật Range-Read (Slice Reading)
- Khi bắt buộc dùng `view_file` / `Read` cho file lớn (> 100 dòng), tuyệt đối không mở toàn bộ file vào context.
- Phải chỉ định rõ `StartLine` và `EndLine` (hoặc lệnh shell `sed -n 'X,Yp'`) để chỉ nạp đúng phân đoạn cần xử lý.

#### 5. Giới hạn Shell Output
- Không chạy lệnh in ra output thô > 40 dòng vào context.
- Luôn pipe giới hạn khi kiểm tra: `git status -s`, `bun test 2>&1 | tail -n 25`, `head -n 30`, `grep -m 10`.
- Khi test pass chỉ cần tóm tắt kết quả (ví dụ `213 pass`).

#### 6. Distillation & Memory Save (Đóng gói tri thức)
- Cuối mỗi turn xử lý logic quan trọng, gọi `memory_save` cô đọng quyết định, trạng thái và bài học.
- Giúp các turn kế tiếp kế thừa trực tiếp từ memory mà không cần đọc lại hàng loạt file cũ.

## core.entrypoints

source: `.cursor/rules/core.entrypoints.mdc`
description: Operator entrypoints are four scripts — never replace a consumer step with raw node/bun/docker

### Entrypoint discipline — the operator surface is four scripts

**Prerequisite:** `core.law-gate.mdc` (`AGENTS.md` Read this session). This rule narrows *how* an
agent may act on a consumer; it does not replace the layout, tooling or verification rules.

#### The rule

An agent may drive a consumer **only** through the repository's operator scripts:

| Allowed | Forbidden |
|---|----|
| `./deploy.sh`, `./provision.sh`, `./verify-consumer.sh`, `./console.sh` | `node …`, `bun …`, `npm …` as the entrypoint of a consumer operation |
| `./fix-consumer.sh`, `./install.sh`, `./harness` (wrapper over the same CLI) | `packages/harness-cli/src/*.mjs`, `init-profile.mjs`, `reconcile-observe-ports.mjs` invoked directly |
| `harness.ps1 <command>` on Windows (thin wrapper → the same `.sh`) | raw `docker`, `docker compose`, `curl` used to *perform* a step the scripts already perform |

Reading is not restricted: `git`, `sed`, `rg`, `gh`, `ls` and `Read` are always fine. The rule is
about **actions**.

#### Two surfaces — dev vs consumer

The table above is about the **consumer**. This repo has a second surface, and the two are not
interchangeable:

| Surface | What it is | How an agent acts |
|---|---|---|
| **dev** (this repo) | `packages/*`, `qc/*`, `docs/*`, `.cursor/*` — the product source | `bun test`, `bun run test`, `bun run build:observatory`, editor tools; `git`/`rg`/`sed` to read |
| **consumer** (x79, fineso, …) | a checkout that has `harness.config.json` | **only** `./deploy.sh` · `./provision.sh` · `./verify-consumer.sh` · `./console.sh` (`harness.ps1` on Windows) |

**`bun test` is a dev command, not an operator step.** It runs inside this repo, so the SLP verify gate
(`core.slp.mdc` §7) runs it directly and that is not a violation of this rule. What the rule forbids is the
opposite direction: using `bun`/`node`/`docker` to *perform* a step a consumer script already performs.

#### Why

The scripts exist so that a behaviour has one definition. `provision.sh` resolves the consumer and
forwards to `harness-cli init profile`; `deploy.sh` resolves it and forwards to `observatory restart`.
When an agent bypasses them, it re-creates the resolution by hand — and hand-written resolution is how
the port moved from `p.port` to `p.observe.port` while `provision.sh`, `deploy.sh` and
`verify-consumer.sh` kept reading the old field with a `|| 8792` fallback. Module tests passed; every
consumer silently reported 8792.

#### If a script cannot do what the step needs

Extend the script and add a case to `qc/entrypoint-scripts.test.mjs`. Do **not** route around it for
"just this once": the next session reads the transcript as precedent, and the bypass becomes the
workflow.

#### Case-by-case consumer run

Each step is a script, and each step's output is the input to the next one's judgement:

1. `./provision.sh <consumer> --plan` — file plan + host tier. Read-only.
2. `./verify-consumer.sh <consumer>` — baseline T-tier. Read-only apart from `.harness/diagnostics`.
3. `./provision.sh <consumer>` — apply. Expect `✅ Provisioned`.
4. `./verify-consumer.sh <consumer> --json` — diff against the step-2 baseline.
5. `./deploy.sh <consumer>` — builds SPA + image, restarts `harness-observatory-<id>`.
6. `./deploy.sh <consumer> --plan` after any failure — confirms what *would* run before re-running.
7. `./console.sh up` then `./console.sh verify` — all five checkpoints against real data.

Exit codes carry the meaning, so never pipe a script through `| head` when the exit code matters and
never flatten 0/1/2 in a wrapper:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | done (or dry run printed) |
| 1 | the operation failed |
| 2 | usage error, or unknown consumer |

#### Windows

`harness.ps1` is a thin wrapper: it finds Git Bash (or WSL with `HARNESS_WSL=1`), translates the
repo path, and execs the matching `.sh` with the same argv. Keeping it thin is the point — a native
PowerShell re-implementation would be a second definition of consumer resolution.

## core.harness-agents

source: `.cursor/rules/core.harness-agents.mdc`
description: harness-eso agent pipeline — AGENTS.md workflow, MCP recon, verify

### Agent pipeline (harness-eso)

**Prerequisite:** `core.law-gate.mdc` — `AGENTS.md` already **Read** this session. Repo **ship** `@mu/harness-*`; không full ESO consumer trên monorepo.

#### Thứ tự (sau `AGENTS.md`)

1. **Yêu cầu** — phân loại: product code (`packages/*`) vs spec/law (x79 `document/harness/**`) vs E2E (verify trên x79).
2. **AgentMemory** — `memory_smart_search` trước task lớn hoặc khi user nhắc context cũ; `memory_save` khi user yêu cầu “nhớ”.
3. **Recon một vòng** — gom Read/Grep/`codegraph_explore`/docgraph trong một lượt; không grep+read lặp sau khi codegraph đã trả source.
4. **Law / contract** — docgraph hoặc Read shard x79 (`core.harness-eso-spec.mdc`); không đoán observe API từ README lẻ.
5. **Implement** — diff nhỏ, ESM `.mjs`, test `node:test` / Vitest theo package.
6. **DeepSeek** — `ask_deepseek_flash` mặc định; `ask_deepseek_pro` khi flash không đủ hoặc user chỉ định. **Không** gọi Brain chỉ để chọn rule/skill/route (System 1 = codegraph + docgraph + policy).
7. **Verify** — `bun test`; UI → `bun run build:observatory` + `bun run test:observatory`; E2E → skill `harness-verify`.

#### Chọn rule theo task

| Path / task | Rule + skill |
|-------------|----------------|
| Luôn | `core.harness-product`, `core.harness-agents` |
| `packages/**` structure | `core.codegraph.mdc` |
| MCP / installers | `core.harness-tooling.mdc` |
| Spec ESO, observe contract | `core.harness-eso-spec.mdc` + `harness-eso-implement` |
| `harness-observe-server/**` | `pkg.observe-server.mdc` |
| `harness-observatory/**`, `harness-console/**` | `pkg.observatory-ui.mdc` |
| `docker/**`, `compose.harness.yml` | `core.harness-product` § Docker |
| `docs/**` mermaid fence | `core.doc.mermaid.mdc` |
| `qc/**` | integration tests sau đổi spine |
| Task chạm **>1 package/tầng** | `core.slp.mdc` + skill `harness-engineering-team` · worker `.cursor/agents/*-runtime.md` |
| gate / evidence / guard / hook | `docs/05.development/09.gate-defect-register.md` §3 + §5 — trước khi sửa |

#### projectPath / cwd

| Nguồn | Root |
|-------|------|
| Code trong monorepo | `harness-eso` (workspace này) |
| Law, WBS, runbook | `../x79` |
| Transcript ingest, `.harness/` consumer | `../x79` (hoặc repo có `harness.config.json`) |

#### Commit

Chỉ commit khi user yêu cầu. Không commit `.harness/`.

## core.law-gate

source: `.cursor/rules/core.law-gate.mdc`
description: Supreme gate — Cursor rules load first; agent MUST Read AGENTS.md before work

### Law gate (forced)

**Cursor injects `.cursor/rules/` → this rule runs first.** Rules do **not** replace law; they route the agent to it.

#### Mandatory (every Agent session)

1. **`Read` repository root `AGENTS.md`** (full file) before planning, MCP recon, or any **Write** / **StrReplace**.
2. Treat **`AGENTS.md` as supreme law** for this repo. `.cursor/rules/*` and skills **summarize** it only.
3. On conflict: **`AGENTS.md` > any rule > any skill > chat guesswork**.

#### After `AGENTS.md` is loaded

Apply always-on rules **in this order** (pointers only — details live in `AGENTS.md`):

1. `core.workspace-isolation.mdc`
2. `core.harness-agents.mdc`
3. `core.harness-product.mdc`

Then glob-matched rules and skills **only if** they do not contradict `AGENTS.md`.

#### Same session

If the user changes scope (observe API, consumer E2E, new package), **re-read `AGENTS.md`** when its sections (tools, layout, verify) become relevant — do not rely on rule memory alone.

#### Not law

`.cursor/instructions.md` is a catalog index only — not a substitute for `AGENTS.md`.

## core.reply-format

source: `.cursor/rules/core.reply-format.mdc`
description: Reply output format — plain markdown, never a JSON envelope

### Reply output format — the answer is text, not a serialization envelope

**Prerequisite:** `core.law-gate.mdc` (`AGENTS.md` Read this session).

#### The requirement

The user reads the assistant's final message directly. It must be **plain markdown text** — the same
bytes a human would type.

Never send the message inside an object or array:

    Forbidden:  {"text": "...", "type": "text"}
    Forbidden:  [{"text": "...", "type": "text"}]
    Forbidden:  any nesting of the above

This is not a style preference. The harness sometimes serializes a response one or more times, and the
user sees `{"text": "[{\"text\": ...}]"}` instead of the answer. It has happened repeatedly, so "be
careful" is not an acceptable control. These mechanisms enforce it instead:

| Mechanism | Role |
|---|---|
| `.cursor/hooks/lib/agent-response.mjs` | The one detector. Fires only when the **whole** text is an envelope — including the host-unescaped shape (`text` already holds `[{...}]`), which is what `afterAgentResponse` actually delivers. |
| `.cursor/hooks/wrapped-output-guard.mjs` (`stop`, `loop_limit: 2`) | The only hook that can act: `afterAgentResponse` supports **no output fields**, so its `agent_message` was discarded. On a wrap, `stop` submits `followup_message` — the reminder to resend as plain text — at most once per turn. |
| `.cursor/hooks/detect-json-wrapper.mjs` (`afterAgentResponse`) | Thin entry point on the same detector, kept for observability (Hooks output channel) and for hosts that do act on `agent_message`. |
| `.cursor/hooks/audit-wrapped-replies.mjs` | Measures the real rate from `~/.cursor/projects/*/agent-transcripts` with the same detector: `node .cursor/hooks/audit-wrapped-replies.mjs --days 30`. |
| `qc/output-wrapper.test.mjs` | Pins the three real samples, the host-delivered shape, **and** the negatives, so the detector cannot start firing on legitimate JSON inside a fenced code block. |

#### Rules for the response body

* Prose, tables, lists and fenced code blocks are fine. Show JSON **inside** a fence — never *as* the
  message.
* Do not emit a JSON object or array as the top-level structure of the reply for any reason, including
  "structured" answers, tool-like payloads, or checklists.
* If a previous turn was wrapped, do not apologise at length — resend the same content as text.

#### Changing the detector

It fires only when the **entire** trimmed response is `{text,type}` or `[{text,type}, …]`, or is a
stringification of one. Ordinary markdown, prose starting with `{`, and fenced JSON blocks are explicit
negative test cases; keep them passing when touching the matcher. A false positive costs a whole extra
turn, so widen the pattern never — widen the *samples*. The unwrapper must terminate on malformed input
— it is called on text that already failed once.

## core.workspace-isolation

source: `.cursor/rules/core.workspace-isolation.mdc`
description: Isolate harness-eso Cursor workspace from x79 — rules, skills, MCP

### Workspace isolation (harness-eso)

**After `core.law-gate` + `AGENTS.md`.** Một **Cursor window = một repo gốc**. Không merge rule/skill/MCP giữa hai workspace.

#### harness-eso (window này)

| Thành phần | Chỉ dùng |
|------------|----------|
| Law agent | `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/rules/*` **trong repo này** |
| Skills | `.cursor/skills/harness-*` — **không** `mu-*`, `brain-dispatch` |
| MCP | `.cursor/mcp.json` — codegraph (**harness-eso**), agentmemory, deepseek (docgraph dùng CLI) |
| Codegraph `projectPath` | Root **harness-eso** (`packages/*`, `qc/*`) |
| Implement | `@mu/harness-*` trong monorepo |

#### x79 (window khác)

| Thành phần | Chỉ dùng |
|------------|----------|
| Rules | `core.harness-consumer`, `core.harness-eso`, `stack.mu.*`, `delivery.*`, … |
| Skills | `mu-*`, `brain-dispatch`, … |
| MCP | `x79/.cursor/mcp.json` — codegraph **x79**, deepseek, … |
| Implement | `backend/mu-*`, `frontend/`, consumer `.harness/` |

#### Chỉ đọc chéo (không import rule x79)

- **Spec / law:** `../x79/document/harness/02.harness-eso/` hoặc `docgraph` CLI với **cwd x79** (`core.harness-eso-spec.mdc`)
- **E2E verify:** mount consumer `HARNESS_REPO_ROOT=../x79` — không copy x79 rules vào đây

#### Cấm

- Áp `stack.mu.*`, `sdlc.gov.*` (x79) lên sửa `packages/harness-*`
- Mở harness-eso nhưng dùng MCP codegraph `--path` trỏ x79 (trừ khi explore consumer-only với `projectPath` tạm)
- Symlink `x79/.cursor/rules` vào harness-eso
